notes:
Inbound SMB self-serve trial. Signed up 2026-02-10, created first API key same day. Initial integration: simple embeddings-based similarity for help center + small chat assistant in product.

What happened: after generating a few test embeddings and 1 short chat session (low token volume) usage dropped to near-zero. No additional keys requested. Customer signaled they were testing 2 vendors in parallel (VellumAI for cheaper per-token + a hosted competitor for built-in retrieval).

Key call notes (FF transcript): Ravi demoed hosted API on 2026-02-18 (ff-2026-02-18-7c9a). Customer liked response quality but called out price and initial cold-start latency on their small instance. "We want something that fits under $X/month for early customers and scales later" (quote from CTO Maya Lin). Also asked about residency / retention — SOC2 + basic audit logs ok for them.

POC touchpoints:
- 2026-02-10: self-serve signup, key issued, onboarding email sent (link to quickstart).
- 2026-02-12: small spike (2 demo requests, 35 embeddings).
- 2026-02-18: scheduled walkthrough w/ AE + SE (recorded). SE suggested batching + prefix caching to save cost; devs said too early to change infra.
- 2026-02-24: follow-up email with custom cost estimate, no reply.
- 2026-03-05: automated churn warning triggered (30d low activity).

Customer constraints / requirements summary:
- Workload: embeddings + lightweight chat (not high concurrency yet).
- Latency target: <300ms p50 for chat (they are tolerant p95 up to 1s).
- Throughput: low, bursty (first 6 months).
- Cost sensitivity: high (startup pricing required).
- Model preferences: open models acceptable; want recommended quantized variants.
- Routing/fallback: prefer single-region hosted; can accept multi-variant fallback if automatic.
- Security: SOC2, retention controls, basic audit logs. No VPC/on-prem required now.

Observed risk indicators: trial stalled after first key, no SDK adoption, competitor demo ongoing, pricing cited as blocker.

Suggested playbook next steps:
- Quick low-effort outreach from Jordan with a 30-min office hours slot, offer $500 extra trial credits to re-run integration and a short checklist (prefab SDK snippets + batching tips).
- Provide explicit cost projection for their expected 0-10M tokens/month usage band and example config with caching to show unit economics.
- Ask for short feedback call to learn why they may favor competitor; capture feature gaps.

Short CRM shorthand / one-liners:
- "Self-serve signup, key used once -> stalled; competitive test vs VellumAI; price is friction."
- "Good demo reaction; CTO wants predictable $/month for early customers."

Next scheduled outreach: 2026-03-10 (Jordan to send playbook + credits offer).
